Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
It's slightly slower / less reactive than Vampidroid (notably on searches) but has some added functionalities.

In the crypt search, when toggling the discipline icons to filter, there's a noticeable delay (about 1 second) because I suppose it starts the search as soon as you toggle it. The right thing to do is to wait that the user has toggled all the filters they want before starting the search (this can be done by waiting 1 second after that the user has toggled something for the last time). This way, the interface doesn't freeze when you start toggling the filters.

There's another annoying thing: the yellow done button should close the filter box once you've selected your filters. Currently, it only helps closing submenu, but when there's no submenu opened, it does nothing.
The filter box should also close when you click outside it.

Also, when listing the vampire, there isn't an option to display its cardtext in the result list. You have to click on it to read it, which is much slower than on Vampidroid.

I don't know if there's a more appropriate place to list those requests but I know Chris reads it so...

Prince of Paris, France

Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
> cordovader wrote:
> the search engine does not work like other tools - example: try searching for minion tap
>
Yes, it does a full text search on the words "minion tap" and will show cards that contain *both* words. So for example it matches glancing blow:

> Do not replace until your untap phase.
> Prevent 1 damage from the opposing minion's strike.
>
Previously such a search would only match the title; however full text search is overall far more useful. Yes, in some cases such as this it seems odd (here due to two very common terms: minion + tap); however overall it is more often beneficial than detrimental.
